scope: P4 source freeze; offline replays of the P3 DAB logs; no model calls or benchmark runs.

focused_pytest.command: python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/unit/agents/test_injected_events.py tests/unit/app/routers/test_advisor_mode_router.py tests/unit/app/routers/test_loops_router.py tests/unit/config/test_advisor_mode_config.py tests/unit/modes/test_advisor_middleware.py tests/unit/modes/test_advisor_mode.py tests/unit/modes/test_advisor_privacy.py tests/unit/modes/test_advisor_trigger.py tests/unit/plugins/test_install_lock.py tests/unit/runtime/test_builder_mode_middlewares.py

broad_pytest.baseline_check: The same tests fail on a clean checkout of the P3 commit 2ebc2cdf6 with the same environment (package installs, Docker, filesystem isolation, network); none touch advisor code.
broad_pytest.channels_excluded_reason: tests/unit/channels needs dingtalk_stream, which is not installed (as in P3-validation.json).

flake8.command: python -m flake8 --extend-ignore=E203 --max-line-length=120 <changed source and test files>

black.detail: All changed files pass except prompts.py, where Black asks for the same two quote-style changes inside P3's frozen ADVISOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT; those bytes are retained, as in P3.

pre_commit_all_files.reason: No module named pre_commit in the test environment.

failure_detection.note: Default thresholds, counters reset at each active consult; valid only up to the first intervention, after which the real trajectory would differ.

privacy_gate.note: A value counts when it is a string cell (at least 4 characters, not numeric, not a field-name key, not in public text) of a result returned before the consult.

conclusion: Advisor tests, lint and offline replays pass; repository-wide failures are pre-existing and environment-dependent. P4 has not been run on a benchmark.
